deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: env=prod-canary, commit=ae3f12c, ref=v2.4.0-canary-2026-03-20

deploy-bot: CI gate status: FAILED -> blocking deploy. Failing checks: lint, smoke-tests. Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/ae3f12c (401s) :x:

maria: ugh lint error looks like the new style rule kicked in only on this PR? @aj can you confirm the rule set changed?

aj: checking now — I didn't intentionally change lint rules in this PR. quick grep...

lucas: smoke-tests failing with DB connection error in setup step. stack: `Error: timeout connecting to test-db:5432`

devops: CI infra shows a transient error creating the ephemeral DB cluster around 02:12 UTC, retrying job might succeed. no infra change deployed.

maria: both lint + smoke failing makes me nervous to force through. would prefer rerun a clean CI first. :thinking_face:

aj: I can trigger a re-run for the build now (no code changes). if it fails again we'll need to decide whether to pin roll back to v2.3.9 for canary.

deploy-bot: Rerun requested by aj. New build queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/ae3f12c/retry-1

deploy-bot: Rerun finished: FAILED. lint still failing (new rule violation in file pkg/proxy/http.go: trailing-space), smoke-tests still failing on DB provision step.

lucas: trailing-space? weird, CI container env maybe stricter whitespace check. could be editor/formatter mismatch.

sre-oncall: Given two non-transient failures + canary now blocked, recommend HOLD on progressing this ref to production canary. Options: (1) pin canary to previous stable tag (v2.3.9) and abort this deploy, (2) open urgent patch PR to fix lint + investigate DB provision and re-run, (3) if patch can't be fast, roll back any partial changes. Thoughts?

maria: option 1 seems safest to keep canary traffic on known-good. we can patch in parallel.

aj: I agree. I'll open a tiny PR to strip trailing whitespace and add a CI retry/better DB backoff, but don't want to risk this rolling into canary while infra is flaky.

devops: I can pin deploy slot to v2.3.9 for canary and cancel the current deploy. doing that now.

deploy-bot: Deployment canceled: reason=CI gate failed (lint, smoke-tests). Canary pinned to v2.3.9 by devops.

sre-oncall: Action items: devops pinned canary -> done, aj to open fix PR -> please reference this thread, maria to follow up on lint rule change, lucas to investigate DB provisioning timeouts and add retries. We'll re-run deploy after fixes and a green CI. 30m hold window for rollout decisions.

maria: noted. I'll check the lint rule commit history and post findings here. :mag:

aj: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/redwood/merge_requests/4821 — includes whitespace fix + test infra tweak. marking WIP until CI green.

sre-oncall: thanks. leaving canary pinned. if CI becomes consistently green we can re-schedule a canary deploy; otherwise we'll escalate to oncall infra.

lucas: adding a short repro for DB provision failure to the ticket.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by deploy-bot: canary-deploy aborted and slot pinned. If any owner marks the build as HOTFIX and requests an expedited deploy, please @release and @sre-oncall.
